title: Yellowed Crispy German Pork Knuckle Roast
description: A traditional German dish featuring a crispy pork knuckle roast, this recipe is a crowd-pleaser and macrobiotic-friendly, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot. The charred and molten exterior gives way to tender and juicy meat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Score the pork knuckle skin in a crisscross pattern, cutting about 1/4 inch deep.
In a small bowl, mix together the caraway seeds, coriander seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork knuckle, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Heat a large ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium-high heat and sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides.
Add the minced garlic, chopped onion, and beer to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the pork knuckle for 20 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 60 minutes.
Add the chopped potato to the pot and continue roasting for another 30 minutes, or until the potato is tender and the pork knuckle is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
